finding: Service secret files were readable beyond their owner
action: Set the files to owner-only access and confirmed the permissions

finding: Leftovers from a retired VPN: a scheduled job, a monitor, and firewall rules
action: Removed the job, the monitor, and all related firewall rules. Confirmed DNS still worked

finding: Unused certificate renewal and dynamic DNS credentials were still present
action: Retired the renewal, regenerated the provider token, deleted the unused domains, and removed the old tool directory. The reverse proxy holds no certificates

finding: SSH accepted password login
action: Switched to key-only login. Confirmed a password attempt is refused and that key login works from both admin machines. Removed an unused key

finding: Four containers used floating image tags
action: Pinned each to the version already running. Confirmed every running image now has a version tag

finding: Two monitoring containers held the Docker socket
action: Removed it from one. Moved the other behind a read-only filtering proxy on a private network. Confirmed with mount listings

finding: Password vault backups were unencrypted archives containing key material
action: Encrypted every archive with a public key and kept the private key offline in two places. Rotated the key after a partial exposure on screen. Deleted all unencrypted archives from the server and the Nextcloud copy. Confirmed the folder is not shared

finding: Published documentation overstated several controls
action: Compared each claim with the live configuration and corrected the documentation. Each control now cites evidence

finding: No second copy of photos, files, and media
action: Blocked on the spare Raspberry Pi drive for stage 1, a second copy on a separate machine. Stage 2, an encrypted offsite copy, was deferred by the owner on 2026-10-12 and is revisited by 2027-04-30. Include database dumps for the photo and file apps, and keep any new backup key offline in two places

finding: No restore runbook, no full restore drill, and no incident exercise
action: Write the runbook. Restore the vault into a scratch service from an encrypted backup, typing the key in from the offline copy. Run a short incident tabletop

finding: Two-factor is not on every service
action: Turn it on for the password manager, files, photos, and budgeting services, and record it in the access control policy

finding: The LAN is flat, with smart home devices next to servers
action: Plan segmentation and test one device group at a time. An earlier attempt was unstable

finding: No battery backup
action: Buy and install a battery backup for the server, router, and switch

finding: Second DNS server is offline
action: Bring the spare Raspberry Pi back as a second resolver and sync it. Waiting on a replacement drive

finding: Container-published ports are not governed by the host firewall
action: Bind sensitive services to localhost or the private network. Add rules for container traffic

finding: Redundant host firewall rules remain
action: Remove rules that duplicate others or allow more than the service needs, then verify

finding: Server and media disks are not encrypted
action: Risk accepted for now with a written reason. Revisit after the second copy exists

finding: No update review cadence or advisory monitoring
action: Set a monthly review. Watch advisories for the services in use. Track end-of-life dates

finding: System disk was more than three quarters full
action: Extended the system volume by 50 GB using free space already in the volume group, while the server kept running. Usage fell from 76 percent to 51 percent

finding: An unused file sharing service was listening on every network interface
action: Reviewed the service. Its only share was empty and never used. Stopped and disabled it and confirmed its ports are closed. Large files now go to the media drive over SFTP with the SSH key

finding: A device offline for months was still on the private network
action: Removed the device from the private network. The quarterly device review is now in the access control policy

finding: Services reached by local name use plain HTTP
action: Add internal TLS for local names where practical

finding: Security events are not collected, reviewed, or alerted on
action: Pick one lightweight option for collecting key logs and alerting on login failures

finding: Documentation gaps: data flows, data metadata, hardware life cycle, and policy review
csf_subcategories: ID.AM-03, ID.AM-07, ID.AM-08, GV.PO-01, GV.PO-02, PR.PS-03
action: Complete the data flow map. Add owner and retention per data set. Hold the first policy review and the first quarterly access review

finding: Private network access rules are permissive
action: Write access rules that limit each device group to the services it needs

finding: Old plaintext vault backups might have remained in a synced desktop folder
action: Searched the administrator's user profile, which holds the synced folder, for unencrypted vault backups. None found

finding: The administrator laptop SSH key had no passphrase
action: Added a passphrase and loaded the key into the operating system SSH agent so daily use stays smooth. Confirmed the key now asks for the passphrase and that login works. Deleted the unprotected safety copy
